description:
1. Create a temporary workspace named "temp_var_inventory" and produce a recursive, machine-readable record of every filesystem entry under /var, saving full paths and basic type info to "temp_var_inventory/raw_listing.txt" and recording any access or read errors to "temp_var_inventory/errors.log".  
2. From "temp_var_inventory/raw_listing.txt", normalize paths, resolve and note symlink targets (logging unresolved links to "temp_var_inventory/errors.log"), filter and deduplicate entries to produce a list containing only regular files, save that list as "temp_var_inventory/file_list.txt", and verify that this prepared file-list is consistent with the raw listing.

What is the total number of files in the /var directory? (recursively)

create.init: echo 123321>/var/tmp.log && echo 123321>/var/dsdd && echo 123321>/var/ppoo && echo 123321>/var/gdss && echo 123321>/var/itcs && echo 123321>/var/ksmx
